name: Inpaint (crop and stitch)
description: Redraw the painted part of a picture at the model's full detail: cut a box around the mask, redraw it at about a megapixel, and put it back through a soft edge, so only the masked part changes.

inputs.name: guidance
inputs.label: Guidance
inputs.description: How closely to follow the prompt (CFG). 1 for distilled models such as Z-Image Turbo and FLUX.2 Klein, which also skips the negative prompt; about 5 to 8 for SDXL and SD 1.5.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.label: Denoise
inputs.description: For a latent from VAE Encode or another Sampler: how far to move from it, 0 keeps it, 1 ignores it. An Empty Latent always starts from noise.

inputs.name: padding
inputs.label: Padding
inputs.description: Pixels of the picture kept around the mask on each side, so the model sees what surrounds it.

inputs.name: megapixels
inputs.label: Megapixels
inputs.description: The crop is resized to about this many megapixels. 0 keeps its size.

inputs.name: blend
inputs.label: Blend
inputs.description: How far the edge of the mask fades outward, in pixels of the picture.
